description.text:
Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated Junior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our global DBA team. This role is ideal for someone with a mid-strong foundational knowledge of SQL Server who is highly passionate about building a long-term career in database administration. While SQL Server is your starting point, you must possess a strong "willing-to-learn" mindset to expand your expertise into Oracle DB. Experience with SAP HANA is a major advantage.
Beyond core DBA duties, you will immediately get involved in data analytics projects and receive formal training to expand your skillset into a Data Engineer.
Key Responsibilities:
* Database Maintenance: Assist in monitoring, backup/recovery, and performance tuning of SQL Server environments.
* Cross-Platform Upskilling: Actively learn and adopt Oracle DB administration tasks under senior guidance.
* Data Engineering & Analytics: Collaborate on analytics projects, building and maintaining data pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Troubleshooting: Respond to database alerts, investigate query performance issues, and assist with user access requests.
* Documentation: Maintain clear documentation for database schemas, backup policies, and system changes.
* Collaboration: Work closely with senior DBA, developing team, and system administration team to ensure data availability and security.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Required Qualifications:
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on experience or academic exposure to MS SQL Server management.
* Core Skills: Strong proficiency in writing and optimizing SQL queries and understanding relational database concepts.
* Career Focus: Clear commitment to pursuing Database Administration as a long-term career path.
* Soft Skills: Curious mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive attitude toward learning new technologies.
Highly Desired Skills: (Pluses)
* SAP HANA: Prior experience, training, or basic knowledge of SAP HANA architecture is a huge plus.
* Analytics Tools: Exposure to ETL tools, MS Fabrics, or data visualization software (e.g., PowerBI).
* Oracle Knowledge: Basic familiarity with Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, or architecture components.
* Certifications: Any foundational certifications in SQL Server, Oracle, or Cloud databases.
